item.title: 67-year-old man hit by pickup truck while crossing street on mobility scooter dies from injuries
item.description: A 67-year-old man has died from his injuries after being struck by a pickup truck while crossing the street using a mobility scooter on Saturday.

item.title: Who's who in the Kouri Richins murder trial?
item.description: Here's what you need to know about those who have appeared during the Kouri Richins murder trial.

item.title: UDOT hits major milestone in University Avenue Bridge project
item.description: The Utah Department of Transportation announced that it has hit a major milestone in construction on the University Avenue Bridge in Provo.

item.title: Horseback riding accident prompts Eagle Mountain equestrian to speak out
item.description: Eagle Mountain has more than 85 miles of trails for horseback riding, as the city has been known for its thriving equine community for years. But with rapid growth in the area, Cedar Haven Ranch equestrian Aleia Price is hoping to raise awareness about roadway etiquette, following a recent incident.

item.title: Bill requiring dropboxes be staffed and voters to show ID abruptly halted at Utah legislature
item.description: Utah's potentially big election reforms stalled on Utah's Capitol Hill on Tuesday after a Senate committee abruptly ended the debate before it even got started and voted not to take any action on a House priority bill that would have added voter ID and dropbox staffing requirements when returning a ballot to a dropbox.

item.title: 'A propaganda goldmine': UVU researcher discusses the impact of AI deepfakes on military conflicts like Iran
item.description: A Utah Valley University researcher explained how AI deepfakes can be used to create misinformation about military conflicts, like the current conflict between the U.S. and Iran, and what we can do to combat it.

item.title: What is PTSD and how does it affect veterans?
item.description: As the United States has entered into another conflict in the Middle East, veterans and their mental health are on the minds of many people, so ABC4 is taking a deeper look at PTSD and how it affects veterans.

item.title: Springville City Council passes ordinance impacting chicken ownership after significant public comment
item.description: During a city council meeting on Tuesday evening, Springville residents spoke against a proposed ordinance amendment that would limit the number of chickens residents could have. The City Council passed the amendments, with some changes.

item.title: UDOT to immediately halt construction on Northern Corridor Project after court ruling
item.description: The Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT) has to immediately stop construction on the controversial Northern Corridor project, following a preliminary injunction in an ongoing lawsuit.

item.title: Creative writing major, Utah native headed to his first Paralympic Winter Games
item.description: Current creative writing major at Weber State University and Utah native Noah Bury is getting ready to compete in Italy for his first Paralympic Winter Games.
